data.body:
rebar-debug final report

Problem: dense completion-verifier runs could exhaust their bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts.

Proven root cause: Pydantic AI may execute a model response's tool batch concurrently, while the completion contract relied only on prompt instructions to serialize evidence and commit actions. Prompt wording cannot enforce one governed action per response, so dense runs deferred every record call until after the budget. The enforcement seam is now explicit at src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:119-171 and composed only for privately flagged completion tools at src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:333-356.

Proof: the original 9895 run observed 0 bank writes after 24 requests/37 repository actions. The unchanged held-out dense oracle produced bounded success 0/3 with policy attachment disabled, while the simple control still passed, ruling out record/schema wiring. Restoring the policy produced 2/3-or-better bounded success and a normal verdict; the final run was 2 passed.

Test: tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:173 is the held-out repeated behavioral oracle; tests/unit/test_completion_tool_policy.py:99 and :132 cover parallel serialization and the third-response fallback. The oracle was RED before repair, hidden from the fixer, GREEN after repair, and returned to RED under the exact defect-seeded mutation (policy disabled), then GREEN again after restoration. It asserts public bank/verdict outcomes, so private refactors do not invalidate it.

Fix: the completion-only wrapper atomically claims one governed action per run_step, counts unique evidence responses for the live first-unbanked id, and invokes the existing record_criterion_verdict callable as provisional met=false at response three if still unbanked. Primary and successor paths attach the same policy at src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py:465-466 and :678. System guidance is the affirmative finite state machine at src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md:262-275 and src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py:70-83; the manifest remains data-only.

Scope and safety: the bounded caller sweep covered build_agent_kwargs, primary completion, successor recovery, bank overwrite/finalization, close/read-only verifier consumers, provider parity, and prefetch. No caller depends on zero-bank exhaustion. The fix restores the documented incremental-banking contract, adds no dependency or public API/schema/config/exit-code change, preserves source=tool and all old vocabulary/workflow/environment surfaces, and weakens no existing test.

Siblings/parity: the operation rule is "completion evidence collection must bank bounded progress before exhaustion." Both primary and successor channels use the same policy; CLI/MCP/library close and read-only verification converge through that shared workflow. No ungoverned parallel completion surface was found. A distinct standing-eval repo-root defect was found, filed as ca47-e124-7462-44d0, and linked discovered_from; it was not widened into this repair.

Residual risk/prevention: ca47-e124-7462-44d0 tracks the observed disposable-fixture repo-path defect. The provisional fallback is model-visible but intentionally retains existing persisted vocabulary for compatibility; accepted here because overwrite remains idempotent and Gerrit review treated extra operator telemetry as non-blocking advisory.

Replication: exact read-only 9895-aa2c-8907-4db6 replication returned PASS for 5 criteria with 8 source=tool bank entries, zero sidecar emits, no status transition, and unchanged updated_at. Focused completion suite passed (126), fidelity/provider-parity checks passed (62), live Bedrock standalone completion passed, full suite passed except one unrelated macOS scheduling flake whose isolated rerun passed. Gerrit change 1560 then passed LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (all 15 CI jobs), zero unresolved comments, and merged as c3aec3eae6.
